VI.description: What a client accepted in this iteration of the server loop gets first\3A the greeting followed by the origin\2C tips and splitters messages as WebSocket text frames\2C plus what RemoteVI Accept Clients.vi needs besides\3A the overlay last sent\2C the window handle\2C the page\2C the access token and view only.

Control.description: What does not change while the share runs\3A the shared VI\2C the page (html)\2C the greeting\2C the frame period in ms\2C the access token\2C view only\2C the share for the status (info) and when it started\2C the port and the shared window (0 when the share is a VI's panel).

What the loop carries from one iteration to the next\3A statistics for the status\2C the last capture\2C the overlay sent\2C the window handle\2C geometry and origin of the panel\2C the tips and splitters messages (read and sent) and the splitter bars\2C the origin sent\2C when the geometry was refreshed\2C VI Stopped checked and a client last clicked\2C the popups (open?\2C their handles\2C the ones hidden on the host\2C their displacement d) and the other windows (tracking state\2C when listed\2C the list).
